text:
frank: Heads-up — release candidate blocked by a tiny regen diff coming from the sample-app onboarding change. CI flagged a semver bump because generated types changed.
ci-bot: buildkite: #5012 failed during yarn regen -> git diff check :x: logs: regen produced changes in src/openapi/onboard.generated.ts
olga: Minimal diff pasted: 
```diff
- export interface OnboardInput { fullName: string; email: string }
+ export interface OnboardInput { email: string; fullName: string }
```
toni: Classic nondeterministic property ordering. Our OpenAPI->typegen path preserves property order unless `--stable` canonicalizes keys.
maya: Why did changelog decide minor? The changelog bot treats any changed file in the tracked fileset as a candidate for bump and picked minor here.
release-bot: merge-block: semver-guard triggered (suggested: minor)
kevin: Short-term fixes I propose: 1) add src/openapi/**/*.generated.ts to .semver-ignore 2) run `yarn typegen --stable` and commit regenerated artifacts 3) ensure CI matrix sets REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false so onboarding script doesn't prompt in runners
frank: Agreed. Also add a lightweight pre-merge check: run `yarn typegen --stable --check` in CI to fail early if authors forgot to regen locally.
olga: I'll open the PR with the .semver-ignore + CI step. Also I'll flip the sample-app CI job to set REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false in the matrix.
ci-bot: olga pushed a branch: regen/semver-ignore -> running build :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: buildkite: #5013 failed — regen step passed but e2e timed out waiting for onboarding prompt :x:
kevin: Looks like the matrix change didn't land on the exact job. Some runners still don't have the env var. We need to add it to the global job config or to the docker runner env.
toni: I can patch the job config. Meanwhile, we should stop treating generated artifacts as meaningfully semver-relevant. The changelog bot should consult a .semver-ignore file before mapping file changes to bumps.
maya: Long-term: make deterministic output the default in typegen (flip `--stable` on by default) and add a flag to opt-out. That avoids opt-in regressions.
frank: Also request infra to pin node/npm across runners. Prettier/tsc outputs vary by minor node/npm differences and cause churn.
olga: Pushed a follow-up: global CI env REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false and updated job YAML. Re-running. :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: buildkite: #5013 rerun passed :white_check_mark:
release-bot: changelog-bot: consulted .semver-ignore -> no releasable change detected. Merge guard cleared.
kevin: Nice. Follow-ups: 1) RFC to default deterministic typegen 2) add PR template checklist item "Did you run `yarn typegen --stable`?" 3) add a devex note on `.semver-ignore` usage and generated artifact naming conventions (use .generated.ts suffix)
maya: I'll author the PR template change and the devex doc.
toni: I'll file the RFC and ping infra about node parity.
frank: Great work. Once the release branch is green I'll merge. Thanks team! :rocket:
